title: MLI策略师：日本30年国债拍卖，全球市场的风向标
speaker: Mark Ranfield

segments.en: This is a huge auctioned in global terms.
segments.zh: 从全球角度看，这是一次规模巨大的拍卖。

segments.en: It's the very long end of bond yields which have upset Mr. Besson, he's got very excited in America, he's talking about during buybacks because he's very concerned about what's happening in Treasury market.
segments.zh: 正是超长期债券收益率让贝森特先生感到不安，他在美国非常激动，谈论回购，因为他非常担忧国债市场的情况。

segments.en: And if you trace back why US Treasury yields have been rising at the long end of the curve, it really comes back to Japan.
segments.zh: 追溯美国长期国债收益率上升的原因，根源在日本。

segments.en: We've got quite a lot of research on Bloomberg over the last few days showing that term premiums in Japan have been rising more quickly than they have in any other part of the G10 complex. And that rising long term premiums in Japan has been filtering through to the US, to Germany, France, the UK, everybody is being affected by what's changing in Japan.
segments.zh: 过去几天彭博研究显示，日本期限溢价上升速度超过G10其他经济体。日本长期溢价上升已传导至美国、德国、法国、英国，各国都受日本变化影响。

segments.en: So when you have a 30-year auction in Japan, the consequence if it doesn't go well, everybody in the rest of the global world has to wake up and say that could be a problem for us.
segments.zh: 因此，当日本进行30年期国债拍卖时，如果结果不佳，全球其他市场都会警醒，这可能成为我们的问题。

segments.en: As it happens, the conditions for today's sale are quite decent. Yields are near the high end of the range, there's still about 4% as we saw in the caption a little bit earlier. There's signs that a little bit of money is coming back from Japanese investors from offshore, back into Japan.
segments.zh: 目前来看，今日拍卖条件相当不错。收益率接近区间高端，仍约4%。有迹象显示日本投资者资金正从海外回流国内。

segments.en: There's speculation that the big pension fund GPIF is going to start tweaking its allocations more towards long-term debt in Japan as well. So things are falling into place to probably make today's auction a decent one in terms of JGB third year.
segments.zh: 有猜测称大型养老基金GPIF将调整配置，增加日本长期债券。因此，今日拍卖可能顺利，日本国债30年期表现可期。

segments.en: I've said that before about auctions and they haven't gone well. If it does fail, it's pretty bad news for treasuries, for German contracts, for the UK, for most of the world.
segments.zh: 我之前也说过拍卖可能不顺。如果失败，对美国国债、德国合约、英国等全球市场都是坏消息。

segments.en: But it does look as though it will pass off OK, and that will be a huge relief because next week the US Treasury is doing 10 and 30 auctions and they won't be too easy either.
segments.zh: 但看起来会顺利通过，这将大大缓解市场压力，因为下周美国财政部将进行10年和30年期国债拍卖，同样不会轻松。
